_doc: Room graph of the key dungeons, for the worst-case small key counts (python -m ootrr.tools.key_graph).
Rooms = DefaultDungeonRoomIndex of the maps (see the room plans). entrance = room where the player enters.

links: rooms = [a, b]; door = open (both ways, no key), locked (chain-locked door: one small key), boss (the boss door: boss key, no small key) or oneway (from a to b only, e.g. a hole); why = how it was found (edit it freely).

propose guesses the links from the maps (doors, rooms that touch): every guess must be checked by hand, missing links added (open passages, ladders, elevators, holes have no door), wrong ones removed. A missing link makes the counts too low. Then set checked to true: only checked dungeons get counts.
